title: A room at the Riverside Hotel
instructions: Listen to a guest and a receptionist. Choose one answer for each question.
transcript:
Receptionist: Good evening. Welcome to the Riverside Hotel. How can I help you?
Guest: Hello. My name is Alex Green. I have a reservation for two nights.
Receptionist: Let me check. Yes, a room for one person, from Friday to Sunday.
Guest: That is right. Is breakfast included?
Receptionist: Yes. Breakfast is in the restaurant on the ground floor. It starts at seven, but on Saturday it starts at half past seven.
Guest: Great. I am meeting a friend at nine tomorrow, so that is fine. Does the room have a view of the river?
Receptionist: No, your room looks onto the garden. It is very quiet. Your room number is two hundred and six, on the second floor. The lift is next to the stairs.
Guest: Thank you. What time do I need to leave the room on Sunday?
Receptionist: Before eleven in the morning. You can leave your bags here after that.
Guest: Perfect. My train is at three, so I will do that.

questions.prompt: How many nights is Alex staying?
questions.explanation: Alex reservou duas noites, de sexta a domingo.

questions.prompt: What time does breakfast start tomorrow?
questions.explanation: A chegada é na sexta-feira. No sábado, o café começa às 7h30.

questions.prompt: What can Alex see from the room?
questions.explanation: A recepcionista informa que o quarto tem vista para o jardim.

questions.prompt: When must Alex leave the room on Sunday?
questions.explanation: O quarto deve ser liberado antes das 11h. O trem das 15h é uma informação diferente.

title: Find the museum
instructions: Use the map and listen to the directions. North is at the top. Start at the station.
map_description: North is at the top. West to east: north row A Library, B Museum, C Park; middle row D Café, E Town hall, F Shop; south row G Station, H Hotel, I Bank. Streets run between the columns and rows. Each move to the next row or column is one block.
transcript:
Visitor: Excuse me. Can you help me find the museum? I am outside the station.
Local: Of course. Look at the map. The station is in the bottom left corner. The top of the map is north.
Visitor: Yes, I can see it. Do I go east, past the hotel?
Local: No. First go north one block. You will reach the cafe. There is a small bus stop outside it.
Visitor: Is that where I turn?
Local: Yes. Turn east and walk one block to the town hall. Then go north one more block. The museum is there, between the library and the park.
Visitor: Thank you. Can I get a drink at the museum?
Local: There is no cafe inside it. You can have a drink at the cafe near the station before you go.
Visitor: Good idea. Is the museum open this afternoon?
Local: Yes. It closes at five, and the last tickets are sold at four thirty.
Visitor: It is only two now. I have plenty of time.

questions.prompt: Which place do you reach after going north one block from the station?
questions.explanation: O café está uma quadra ao norte da estação.

questions.prompt: Which letter marks the end of the route?
questions.explanation: O percurso é G → D → E → B: norte, leste e norte novamente.

questions.prompt: What is the latest time to buy a ticket?
questions.explanation: Os últimos ingressos são vendidos às 16h30. O museu fecha às 17h.

title: A Saturday with friends
instructions: Listen to two friends making plans. For the first question, choose exactly TWO activities.
transcript:
Maya: What shall we do on Saturday, Ben? We could go swimming or see a film.
Ben: The swimming pool is closed this weekend. And I went to the cinema yesterday.
Maya: What about a bike ride? The weather report says it will be sunny in the morning.
Ben: That sounds good. We can ride beside the river. But I need to be home by one because my sister is visiting.
Maya: Let's meet at the park gate at ten, then. We can ride for an hour and have lunch at the market afterwards.
Ben: I like that idea. The market has a new food stall with vegetable sandwiches. My sister told me they are very good.
Maya: Great. Shall I bring my camera?
Ben: Yes, and bring a bottle of water. There are no shops along the river path.
Maya: I will. Do we need to book a table at the market?
Ben: No. We can sit on the benches outside. I will bring some cash because the new stall does not take cards yet.
Maya: See you at ten on Saturday!

questions.prompt: Which TWO activities do Maya and Ben agree to do?
questions.explanation: Eles combinam pedalar e almoçar no mercado. A piscina está fechada e Ben já foi ao cinema.
Maya propõe o portão do parque como ponto de encontro, às dez.
